source.name: Icelandic Glacial - Cleeks Golf Club Partners with Icelandic Glacial Ahead of 2026 LIV Golf Season
source.quote: Cleeks Golf Club today announced a partnership with premium natural spring water brand Icelandic Glacial ahead of the 2026 LIV Golf season
source.note: Club partnership announcement carried on Icelandic Glacial's site; brand is featured on the players' golf bags as part of the team's on-course identity.

source.name: LIV Golf - Our Partners (New Era, Official Suppliers)
source.quote: New Era is a supplier partner and the Official Cap of LIV Golf and it's 13 teams
source.note: League-wide official supplier; New Era's logo is one of the two partner logos on the official Cleeks GC team page (livgolf.com/cleeks-gc, opened 2026-10-03). Page undated; opened 2026-10-03.

summary: Team partners 2026: Icelandic Glacial and New Era. Captain: Martin Kaymer. sponsorsComplete is false because no cited source documents a complete list of the club's sponsors; the club's team page on livgolf.com shows the two partner logos above, but LIV team pages do not document shirt-level placements (see the liv-golf league note).
